proposals.diff_summary: CLAUDE.md's session-init step 1 already says 'if values are empty or missing, run bootstrap_session.sh first', but every observed violation happened AFTER session init had already completed successfully -- the instruction reads as a one-time init-time check, so once an agent is mid-task and discovers a specific issue's item ID is missing (because the issue was created after the last session-context.env refresh), it silently falls through to hand-written GraphQL instead of re-running the one cheap script. Added a standing paragraph directly after the init checklist stating this rule applies for the whole session, not just at start, and explicitly forbidding hand-rolled board queries/pagination loops as a substitute.
proposals.expected_impact: Each observed incident cost 5-8 extra tool-call turns and multiple multi-KB paginated GraphQL responses (full board dumps at up to 100 items/page, some walked across 5+ pages, one incident additionally mis-guessed the repo owner and retried) versus one bootstrap_session.sh call. This pattern recurred in 3 of the 10 sampled transcripts (7408f95c, 102b140e, c8beb655) -- plausibly a meaningful share of the +7% tokens-per-issue regression observed this run vs 2026-07-21's baseline. Conservatively ~5,000-15,000 tokens and 5+ turns avoided per future incident.

proposals.diff_summary: Issue #774 added the 'How to deploy' requirement to dev-workflow/pr-review SKILL.md, but dev-workflow's own description ('the mandatory issue-to-PR workflow for developers (Mid and Junior)') and agents/pm.md's skill-routing table both frame it as a Mid/Junior-only skill. When the PM implements an issue directly per its own explicit permission ('Complex issues: implement yourself'), nothing routes it back to dev-workflow's checklist -- confirmed by this session doing exactly that on two PRs (#785, #790) and skipping the section on both, caught only by user inspection after merge. Added a row to pm.md's skill-routing table pointing self-implementation at dev-workflow, plus an explicit reminder at the 'implement yourself' line naming the How-to-deploy section specifically (the step most likely to be skipped, since it's the newest addition to the checklist).
proposals.expected_impact: Prevents the exact recurrence this session hit: 2 merged PRs missing the section, 1 user-noticed gap, 2 retroactive gh pr edit round-trips post-merge to fix the record. Going forward, saves that whole correction cycle (~1 user turn + 2-4 tool calls) on every PR the PM opens directly instead of delegating -- and closes the gap #774 was meant to close but didn't, since #774 only touched the skill files a self-implementing PM was never routed to.
